Jaipur luxury private tour

Amber · City Palace · 2 days

2 days Jaipur tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Jaipur with the good timings: Amber Fort at opening, the stepwell before the coaches, and sunset from the hills above the city.

At a glance

Duration
2 days
Route
Amber · City Palace
Tour type
Private — your party only
Guide
Licensed, English speaking

What makes this one worth it

  • Amber Fort at opening time
  • Panna Meena ka Kund and Jal Mahal
  • City Palace, Jantar Mantar and Hawa Mahal
  • Sunset at Nahargarh Fort

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Amber Fort, the stepwell and the City Palace

    Amber Fort as the gates open, Panna Meena stepwell, Jal Mahal and an afternoon in the City Palace complex.

  2. Day 2

    Hawa Mahal, the bazaars and sunset at Nahargarh

    Hawa Mahal at first light, the old city bazaars, a craft workshop, and sunset at Nahargarh before departure.

What the price covers

  • One night in a heritage hotel with breakfast
  • Private AC car and chauffeur
  • Licensed Jaipur guide
  • All monument tickets
  • Taxes and parking

What it does not cover

  • Lunch and dinner
  • Elephant ride at Amber
  • Shopping
  • Tips
